# Snapsight

> Snapsight is AI software for live events. One audio feed from each room gives every attendee live text, translation, key takeaways, an Idea Cloud and a summary on their own phone, from a QR code or link with no app. Afterwards, Remix turns the same sessions into post-event reports, sponsor reports and decks, and Speaker Remix gives each speaker a branded card and post to share. Live text translation is free for every event; voice translation is $10 per language per session, Engage is $299 per event, and Pro is $249 per session or from $99 in packs. Snapsight is headquartered in Singapore.

Plans, in USD before tax: Free ($0): live text translation in every room, up to 100 sessions a year. Engage ($299 per event): your branding, sponsor logos, Speaker Remix and Q&A moderation across one event. Pro ($249 per session of up to 2 hours), or packs of 20 for $3,980, 50 for $7,450, 100 for $9,900, used across events within 12 months; packs include Engage. Voice translation: $10 per language per session, on every plan. Extra Remix credits: 20 for $19. Enterprise: beyond 100 sessions a year, on request.

Book a demo: https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/contact. Every link below is a Markdown copy of a page on https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/; the page itself is the same URL without "index.md". The full text of every page is in https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/llms-full.txt.

## Products

- [Live translation](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/translate/index.md): Snapsight live translation lets every attendee follow a conference session on their own phone, in their own language, from a QR code or link with no app. Reading the translated live text is free for every event; hearing a translated voice through their own earbuds costs $10 per language per session.
- [Live captions](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/live-captions/index.md): Snapsight shows live captions of every session on each attendee’s own phone, in the speaker’s language or translated into theirs, from a QR code or link with no app. Live captions are free for every event, in every room. English transcription is 97% accurate with a direct feed from the sound desk.
- [Takeaways and Idea Cloud](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/takeaways/index.md): Snapsight Takeaways gives every attendee the key points of a session on their own phone while the speaker is still talking, with an Idea Cloud of the session’s themes and a summary when it ends. Every takeaway links back to the speaker’s own words. It costs $249 per session of up to 2 hours, or from $99 a session in packs.
- [Remix](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/remix/index.md): Snapsight Remix turns the sessions you pick into post-event reports, sponsor reports, LinkedIn carousels, one-pagers and decks, drafted from what was actually said on stage. Every quote carries its speaker and session, and you ask for changes until the draft is right. The Decarbonised Mine finished weeks of post-event work over a weekend.
- [Speaker Remix](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/speaker-remix/index.md): Snapsight Speaker Remix gives every speaker a private link to turn their own session’s takeaways into a card in your event’s design and a draft post they can edit. Nothing is shared until the speaker shares it. London Community Week made a card for all 49 of its speakers.
- [How it works](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/how-it-works/index.md): Running Snapsight at an event takes one audio feed from the sound desk to a laptop running Snapsight, and one QR code per session. Attendees follow on their own phones, Snapsight’s team runs a sound check with you before doors open, and the takeaways feed reports and speaker posts afterwards.
- [Integrations](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/integrations/index.md): Snapsight works inside any event app that can embed a web page or open a link, including Swapcard, Cvent, Bizzabo, Whova, Grip and EventsAir, with no formal integration needed. It takes audio from Zoom, Microsoft Teams and Google Meet sessions, supports SSO on Enterprise, and sends takeaways and summaries to your systems over the API or MCP.
- [Try a real event session](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/experience/index.md): Snapsight’s experience page runs a live demo: choose an audio source (your microphone, a YouTube video or a sample conference talk), the speaker’s language and up to three translations, and see live text, translation and AI insights in seconds. You can also open a real event session as attendees saw it, and see a report and speaker card made from event sessions.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/pricing/index.md): Snapsight’s live text translation is free for every event, in every room, up to 100 sessions a year. Engage is $299 per event for your branding, sponsor logos, Speaker Remix and Q&A moderation; Pro is $249 per session of up to 2 hours for takeaways, summaries and transcripts, or $199, $149 and $99 a session in packs of 20, 50 and 100 that include Engage; voice translation is $10 per language per session. Prices are in USD before tax.
- [Event translation cost calculator](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/tools/event-translation-cost-calculator/index.md): Snapsight’s calculator estimates what translating an event costs with human interpreters and with Snapsight, from your rooms, days, sessions and languages. Interpreter figures use published AIIC, UN, EU and US Courts rates; Snapsight’s live text translation is free and voice is $10 per language per session.

## Solutions

- [Trade shows and exhibitions](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/solutions/trade-shows/index.md): Snapsight puts every seminar theatre and stage at a trade show on attendees’ phones: live text and translation during each session and takeaways they can read from the show floor. Afterwards, Remix drafts post-event and sponsor reports from what was said. Tech Week Singapore, Informa Tech’s ATxEnterprise, The Meetings Show and IMEX have run it.
- [Conferences and congresses](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/solutions/conferences/index.md): Snapsight gives conference attendees live text and translation during each talk and a summary by QR code as soon as it ends, across every room and track, and Remix drafts the post-event reports. Economist Impact had session highlights out the same day, ARC APAC Summit ran it across a dense medical programme, and FIP offered real-time translations of every presentation in its congress app.
- [Associations](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/solutions/associations/index.md): Snapsight captures every session at an association congress: live takeaways in your conference app or by QR code, and a report for members afterwards. FIP put takeaways from every presentation in its congress app, AICPA & CIMA had Snapsight draft its advisory group’s report, and CityDNA’s team of four reached 65% of attendees.
- [Community events and festivals](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/solutions/community-events/index.md): Snapsight lets a small team capture a big programme: live takeaways and translation in the languages spoken on stage, and a card for every speaker afterwards. Two people ran it for 130+ activities at Festival of Curiosity, GSTC2025 offered multilingual summaries to delegates from more than 40 countries, and London Community Week turned 49 speakers into 147 LinkedIn posts.
- [Corporate events and summits](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/solutions/corporate-events/index.md): Snapsight summarises every session at a corporate event or leadership meeting and drafts a report from what was said, which your team then finishes. AICPA & CIMA used it for its Future of Finance Leadership Advisory Group report, Identiverse 2024 had insights for all 250+ sessions, and the Singapore Apex Business Summit 2024 got a report for each of four audiences.
- [Sponsors](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/sponsors/index.md): Snapsight gives organisers new sponsorship inventory: a sponsor can present the takeaways, Idea Clouds and summaries from every session, and the post-event reports attendees come back to. Logos appear on stage screens, in the event app, on reports and on speaker cards. You sell it in your own tiers, at your price.
- [Accessibility](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/accessibility/index.md): Snapsight makes sessions easier to follow for every attendee: live captions on their own phone, translation to read or hear, and takeaways and summaries they can come back to. There is no app. Through All Minds, events built around neuroinclusion can get Snapsight at subsidised or no cost.
- [All Minds](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/all-minds/index.md): All Minds is a Snapsight partnership for events built around neuroinclusion, offering Snapsight at subsidised or no cost depending on the situation. In return, organisers work with Snapsight to learn which formats actually help, and with their consent the findings are shared with the industry.
- [Partners](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/partners/index.md): Snapsight has two partner programmes for agencies, PCOs, DMCs, AV and production companies and event tech resellers. Resellers put Snapsight on their own quotes at wholesale rates; white-label partners run it under their own logo, colours and domain, as part of Enterprise. IAPCO names Snapsight a Service Provider Partner.

## Customer stories

- [All customer stories](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/resources/case-studies/index.md): Eighteen published stories show how organisers run Snapsight at trade shows, conferences, association congresses and festivals, including Economist Impact, ATxEnterprise, Tech Week Singapore, ARC APAC Summit, The Decarbonised Mine and London Community Week. Each story gives the event, what was run and what happened, with the figures the organiser reported.
- [AI Innovation Asia 2024](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/resources/case-studies/redefining-event-intelligence-the-economists-ai-innovation-asia-2024/index.md): Session highlights the same day, not 48 hours later. Economist Impact gave 500 executives summaries of every session by QR code, with real-time translation.
- [ATxEnterprise 2024](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/resources/case-studies/atxenterprise-2024-empowering-connections-through-ai/index.md): Five stages, 400+ sessions. Takeaways on screen and in hand. Key takeaways on screen at all five stages, and on attendees’ phones by QR code, with no app to download.
- [ARC APAC Summit 2025](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/resources/case-studies/arc-apac-summit-2025/index.md): A dense medical programme. 40% of attendees used Snapsight. Real-time transcription and summaries for 20+ jargon-heavy healthcare sessions.
- [The Decarbonised Mine](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/resources/case-studies/the-decarbonised-mine-how-atwo-day-mining-conferencereplaced-weeks-of-post-eventwork-with-snapsight/index.md): Weeks of post-event work, finished over a weekend. A two-day mining conference replaced its record-edit-transcribe-write-design routine with summaries and reports from Snapsight.
- [Tech Week Singapore 2024](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/resources/case-studies/tech-week-singapore-2024-how-snapsight-helped-26000-attendees-stay-on-top-of-500-sessions/index.md): 17 stages, 500+ sessions. 13,773 content views. QR codes on all 17 stages gave 26,000+ attendees the takeaways from sessions they couldn’t reach.
- [Festival of Curiosity](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/resources/case-studies/festival-of-curosity-linz-2025/index.md): Two people, 130+ activities. Months of content from one festival. A two-person team captured a bilingual festival in German and English, Austrian dialect included.
- [WiT Japan & North Asia 2024](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/resources/case-studies/wit-japan-north-asia-2024-elevating-event-experiences-through-ai-powered-insights/index.md): Live within a week, run by one person. One person handled AV, setup and integration, and attendees used the insights for their own reports.
- [CityDNA International Conference 2025](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/resources/case-studies/citydna-international-conference-budapest-2025/index.md): An organising team of four. 65% of attendees used it. Transcripts, summaries and translation across 15+ sessions, with a QR code printed on every badge.
- [London Community Week 2026](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/resources/case-studies/london-community-week-speaker-remix/index.md): 49 speakers. 147 LinkedIn posts. A card for every speaker, shared across three official Pages for weeks after the event.
- [The Meetings Show 2025](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/resources/case-studies/tms-2025-case-study-snapsight-ai/index.md): Three stages at once. Every attendee got all 65 sessions. Live text, key takeaways and Idea Clouds for every session on three main stages, readable in 99 languages.
- [IMEX Frankfurt 2024](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/resources/case-studies/frankfurt-2024redefining-event-excellencewith-ai/index.md): 150+ education sessions, without leaving the show floor. Summaries and Idea Clouds for every education session, inside the IMEX app and one scan from each room.
- [PCMA Convening Leaders 2024](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/resources/case-studies/convening-leaders-2024-elevating-the-attendee-experience-with-ai-powered-insights/index.md): 5,000 attendees. 2,000 of them used Snapsight. Real-time summaries and Idea Clouds, including for the Clinton keynote, with takeaways in seven languages.
- [ICCA Congress 2024](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/resources/case-studies/icca-congress-2024-abu-dhabi/index.md): 60+ sessions summarised. The whole congress on one screen. Live takeaways for every session and an event-wide Idea Cloud on a four-sided display hung over the venue.
- [IMEX America 2024](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/resources/case-studies/snapsight-imex-america/index.md): 15,800 participants. Session takeaways in the IMEX app. Session takeaways in the IMEX app for a show with 15,800 participants and 85,000 meetings.
- [ASAE AI Summit 2024](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/resources/case-studies/asaes-ai-summit-empowering-associations-with-insights/index.md): A survey on Day 1. Its findings in the Day 2 keynote. Session summaries for 500+ association executives, and a survey analysed in under 24 hours.
- [UFI European Conference 2024](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/resources/case-studies/from-experiment-to-essential-ufis-ai-journey-across-continents/index.md): Tried in Macau in March. Standard in Zurich by June. UFI’s own tech team put takeaways into the conference app, with no code.
- [The Meetings Show APAC 2024](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/resources/case-studies/the-meetings-show-apac-revolutionizing-event-experiences-with-real-time-insights/index.md): 23 main-stage sessions. One white paper for everyone else. Takeaways flashed on screen after every main-stage session, then shared with the whole community as a white paper.
- [BEIA Conference & AGM 2024](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/resources/case-studies/driving-event-innovation-how-beia-transformed-content-engagement-with-ai/index.md): One volunteer ran it for the whole conference. After a 15-minute test at home, one volunteer ran Snapsight for 170 industry leaders.

## Guides

- [AI translation and captioning buyer's guide](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/guides/ai-translation-captioning-buyers-guide/index.md): Snapsight’s buyer’s guide sets out how to choose AI translation and captioning for an event: twelve questions to ask every vendor, five checks to run on your own sessions, eight red flags, and a 24-point scorecard. The emailed version adds when to choose AI or an interpreter, and an RFP.
- [Blog, cost guides, glossary and comparisons](https://www.snapsight.com/en/resources/blog/): Articles on live translation, captions, interpretation costs and event content

## Trust and company

- [Security](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/security/index.md): Snapsight hosts event content on AWS in Frankfurt, backups included, encrypts it with AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit, and never uses it to train AI models; your data, and the IP in it, belongs to you. Every service that handles the data is named with where it runs, and certificates download from the trust centre at trust.snapsight.com.
- [About Snapsight](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/about/index.md): Snapsight is a Singapore-headquartered company building AI for live events, with a team across Asia, Europe and North America. Its products give attendees live translation and takeaways on their own phones and give organisers reports, posts and speaker cards from the same sessions.
- [Careers](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/careers/index.md): Snapsight is hiring across sales, customer success and engineering to build AI that people use on stage, in the audience and after the event. Each job page lists its location, working arrangement and how to apply.
- [Press center](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/press-center/index.md): Snapsight’s press centre lists its announcements, press releases and trade-press coverage since 2024, newest first, including the launch of Remix on 13 May 2026. Its press kit has the boilerplate, key facts, logos, product images and event photos to download, and press enquiries go to cs@snapsight.com.
- [Contact and demo requests](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/contact/index.md): Talk with Snapsight about your next event. Book a demo, explore platform fit, and get expert guidance on transcription, translation, and event intelligence.
- [Job: Senior Account Executive](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/careers/senior-account-executive/index.md): Lead complex sales for Snapsight, build relationships across event organisations, and help shape how the team wins and grows customer accounts.
- [Job: Account Executive](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/careers/account-executive/index.md): Own the sales conversation from discovery to a signed agreement. Help event organisers see what Snapsight can do for their audience, their content and their next event.
- [Job: Inbound Sales Development Representative](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/careers/inbound-sales-development-representative/index.md): Be the first useful conversation a potential customer has with Snapsight. Read the inbound signal, qualify the opportunity and turn interest into a well-prepared meeting.
- [Job: Customer Success Representative](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/careers/customer-success-representative/index.md): Help customers run successful events with Snapsight. Own onboarding, live remote support and the delivery of useful content after the last session.
- [Job: Full Stack Engineer](https://www.snapsight.com/snapsight-website-preview/careers/full-stack-engineer/index.md): Build the software behind Snapsight’s live and post-event experience. Take useful product ideas from interface and API through to reliable production behaviour.
- [Trust centre](https://trust.snapsight.com/): Certifications, policies and subprocessors
- [Help centre](https://support.snapsight.com/): Product documentation and support
